background: Societe Generale is one of France's three largest banks, a universal bank with French retail networks, a large derivatives-driven investment bank, the Ayvens car-leasing business and banking subsidiaries in Africa and Central Europe.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest of them at A, with outlooks split one negative, one positive and one stable; the last move was a two-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. The balance sheet is on the weak side of EU and Nordic banks, with CET1 of 13.2%, leverage of 4.3% and NSFR of 115% all in the bottom quarter and LCR of 146% below the peer median. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Sep 2026.
